title: Document similarity retrieval for patent prior art
abstract: Techniques for computing similarity between uploaded technical documents and a corpus of patent abstracts to support prior art searches.

title: System for semantic search over intellectual property assets
abstract: A system that indexes intellectual property documents and applies vector similarity metrics to identify related patents.

title: Optical character recognition for technical drawings
abstract: Methods for extracting text from technical drawings and converting the output into searchable text for patent analysis.

title: Automated classification of invention disclosures
abstract: An automated pipeline for classifying invention disclosures and mapping them to patent classification codes.

title: Cloud-based workflow for patent filing management
abstract: A workflow system that manages patent filing tasks, document storage, and legal review approvals.
